summary.text: Son of Dionysus born on Lemnos with Ariadne, and one of the Argonauts who sailed with Jason for the Golden Fleece.

story.text: Apollodorus numbers Staphylus among the sons Dionysus begat on Ariadne after he brought her to Lemnos — Thoas, Staphylus, Oenopion, and Peparethus.
In the roll of the Argonauts, Staphylus sails beside Phanus as a son of Dionysus on the voyage to Colchis.
